rationale: Roberts is likely to keep assignment and produce a narrow Takings-only opinion adopting Kagan’s rebuttable-presumption framework (sale price strong evidence but not dispositive where the regime materially diverges from market conditions). Alito and Kavanaugh are likely to dissent on administrability/tradition grounds favoring a proceeds-only benchmark, while Thomas and/or Gorsuch may concur to emphasize original meaning and resist any drift toward an appraisal mandate or Eighth Amendment analysis.
